title: Final State Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the state of the electron at time T.

title: Perturbation Treatment
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply time-dependent perturbation theory to analyze the effect of the magnetic field.

title: Eigenstate Verification
description: Important Criteria: The student must demonstrate that the final state is an eigenstate of the Hamiltonian with the correct eigenvalue.

title: Sufficient Time Explanation
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain what is meant by 'sufficiently long' in the context of time T.

title: Perturbation Hamiltonian
description: Optional Criteria: The student may include the correct form of the perturbation Hamiltonian used in the calculations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or neglecting terms of order (H_x/H_z)^2.

title: Integration Steps
description: Optional Criteria: The student may show the integration steps clearly for calculating the coefficient a_-.

title: Physical Interpretation
description: Optional Criteria: The student may provide a physical interpretation of the results obtained.
